mechanism_description: One narrow dev-only cross-sectional breadth ignition regime probe using stable liquid participation as an earlier risk-on permission signal against phase67j_no_neo_main.

entry_requires: causal smoothed breadth ignition is ON
existing hard BTC risk-off invalidation is false
exit_requires: existing hard BTC risk-off invalidation becomes true

breadth_signal.universe_definition: Fixed liquid core universe from data/ohlcv only: ADA, AVAX, BNB, BTC, DOGE, DOT, ETH, LINK, LTC, SOL, TRX, XRP. An asset is daily eligible only after its own 120-day moving average is available; the breadth signal is valid only when at least 8 of the 12 fixed assets are eligible.
breadth_signal.breadth_formula: For each date, breadth = count(eligible assets with close > own 120-day SMA and own 20-day SMA > own 120-day SMA) / count(eligible assets).
breadth_signal.smoothing_rule: Smooth daily breadth with one causal EWMA using span=21 trading days, adjust=false, and min_periods=21.
breadth_signal.threshold_rule: Breadth ignition candidate is true when causal smoothed breadth is at least 2/3, with the fixed-universe minimum eligibility rule already satisfied.
breadth_signal.persistence_rule: Ignition turns ON only after the threshold candidate is true for 3 consecutive available days.
